title: The reveal
notes: Summit Express top. A rising crane with a push down the line, from 2.5 m above the snow just below the crest (chairs large at the left) to 13 m above the slope, ending on the frame of ref/a-top-2.jpg: the line, the valley, the river and the town. The top station (4322.5, -2621.5) and its cut bank stay behind the camera for the whole move. Ground: 1486.6 at x 4315, 1482.9 at x 4300. Take 2 used 45 mm and Time of Day 11. Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60).
